top_signals.title: Branches of K-Shaped Economy Diverging Even Wider: Clarida
top_signals.summary: Former Federal Reserve Vice Chairman Richard Clarida, and now a global economic adviser for Pimco, talks to Tom Keene and Scarlet Fu on"Bloomberg Money". Clarida endorsed the view that the US has a so-called K-shaped economy, with the divergence between its two branches widening over the past six to seven years.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Luxury Real Estate Firm Serhant Expands into Texas Amid Booming Market
top_signals.summary: Ryan Serhant, CEO and Founder of luxury real estate firm Serhant, discusses the company's strategic expansion into Texas, highlighting the state's robust job growth and entrepreneurial environment. Texas leads the nation with over 3.5 million startups and small businesses, and more Fortune 500 headquarters than any other state, driving a strong luxury housing market with $25 billion in residential sales over $1 million in the past year. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: George Santos to Pay $35,000 Over ‘Manipulative’ Kalshi Bet
top_signals.summary: Former Congressman George Santos agreed to pay more than $35,000 to settle allegations he manipulated a wager on prediction market platform Kalshi about whether he’d attend the 2026 State of the Union.
